4d0774810da92539.description: The Ground Operation Officer supports daily last mile delivery operations by receiving, organizing, verifying, and handing over orders to riders and drivers. The role ensures smooth and timely dispatch, maintains a safe and organized hub, and escalates operational issues when required. The role works closely with Ground Operation Supervisors, riders, drivers, Order Care, Acquisition, and warehouse teams to maintain smooth and efficient delivery operations. The Ground Operation Officer is also responsible for maintaining a safe and organized working environment, supporting peak-demand operations, and escalating operational issues when required. High school diploma or equivalent. 1 – 2 years of experience in logistics, delivery, or operations. Experience in coordinating with drivers/captains and ensuring compliance with SOPs Knowledge of safety and security protocols in a logistics or aviation environment. Ability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required. Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office, Logistics Software). Good attention to detail and time management. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

4d65fd198d2054d0.description: About Landees Playground Landees Playground is a recreational facility dedicated to providing a safe and engaging environment for children and visitors. The focus is on delivering enjoyable play experiences and fostering a welcoming atmosphere for families. Working at Landees offers the opportunity to interact with diverse guests and contribute to a positive environment. The Role of Coffeeshop Cashier The Coffeeshop Cashier is a full-time, on-site position located in Jeddah, Makkah. This role is responsible for providing friendly and efficient service at the coffeeshop counter, including greeting guests, taking orders, and accurately processing payments. Key Responsibilities Handle cash and operate POS systems accurately and efficiently for payment processing. Provide strong customer service, including clear communication, active listening, and a welcoming attitude towards guests. Apply basic food and beverage handling skills, adhering to cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards. Monitor inventory to ensure product availability. Qualifications and Requirements Previous experience (0-1 years) in retail, hospitality, or café environments is an advantage but not required. Demonstrated friendly demeanor with children and parents. Reliability and punctuality are essential. Ability to work effectively in a busy, team-oriented environment. Work Environment This is an on-site, full-time role within Landees Playground in Jeddah. The position requires interaction with diverse guests in a dynamic, fun-oriented setting.

4dc47fabfad70a7c.description: About the Role Green Barns Health is conducting an international recruitment campaign for experienced Consultant Surgeons specializing in Cardiac Surgery. These full-time senior appointments are available across various cities in Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Qassim, Hail, Tabuk, Abha, and Jazan. The campaign is particularly aimed at Consultants currently practicing in the UK, Ireland, and Europe who are considering relocation. Candidate Profile We are seeking Consultant Surgeons with a specialization in Cardiac Surgery who are currently practicing at a Consultant level. Candidates must demonstrate recent relevant specialist practice, appropriate professional registration, a clear specialist career history, and a genuine interest in relocating to Saudi Arabia. The appointments are subject to specific professional training, specialist qualification, and experience requirements set by the hiring organization. Qualifications and Experience A recognized postgraduate medical qualification or board certification equivalent to the Saudi Board is required. Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in Cardiac Surgery at a Consultant level. Recognized qualification routes will be assessed during the application process. Work Structure and Compensation The standard working requirement for this full-time position is 48 hours per week. On-call duties will be determined by the operational needs of the hospital, with a typical frequency not exceeding one in every three days. The salary for this role ranges from SAR 50,000 to SAR 67,000. Location and Environment Opportunities are primarily available in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Qassim, Hail, Tabuk, Abha, and Jazan. These cities offer robust infrastructure, access to international airports, international schools, shopping facilities, and family amenities. Specific location details and appointment information will be discussed with suitable candidates during the recruitment process. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to upload their current CV and complete the short application form. Green Barns Health will confidentially review professional backgrounds against the current specialist surgical requirements. Candidates whose subspecialty, qualifications, and experience align with the criteria will be contacted. Green Barns Health does not charge candidates any recruitment or introduction fees.

4dd69fc46f3f5892.description: About the Role ****** is seeking an Operations and Security Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves comprehensive platform monitoring, incident response, and the implementation and operation of security controls. The engineer will be responsible for ensuring platform stability and security across various environments. Key Responsibilities Monitor the platform continuously, respond to alerts, troubleshoot issues, and restore services. Manage emergencies both during and outside office hours, and prepare client reports as requested. Perform patching, hardening, and regular vulnerability reviews on all components, ensuring endpoint protection compatibility. Implement and operate security controls including identity and access with MFA, RBAC, and single sign-on; pervasive encryption; separated development, test, and production environments; signed and verified automation code; file-type whitelisting; and mobile-device restrictions. Manage security logging, audit logs, and SIEM integration, with measures to protect logs from tampering. Secure APIs using gateway solutions, OAuth , and OWASP API security best practices. Oversee backups, business continuity, and disaster recovery, including regular testing. Lead incident response, ensuring immediate notification, initial reports within 24 hours, and documented procedures with SLAs and escalation paths. Develop security architecture and API design documents, infrastructure components of the architecture pack, and bi-monthly operations reports. Required Qualifications and Skills Proficiency in Linux and Windows server administration on public and sovereign clouds (*, GCP, OCI, Deem). Administration experience with at least two of Qlik Sense, Talend, Dataiku, and MS SQL Server, in addition to GCP services. Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (*, Cloud Logging and Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana) and runbook development. Demonstrated ability in incident management, including triage, escalation, and root-cause analysis. Expertise in identity and access management: IAM, MFA, RBAC, and SSO integration. Knowledge of encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and certificates. Skills in vulnerability scanning, patching, hardening, and working with endpoint-protection tools. Experience with SIEM integration and audit-log design. Familiarity with API gateways, OAuth , and OWASP API Security Top Ten principles. Capability in cloud-based backup, restore, business continuity, and disaster recovery. Desirable Skills and Certifications Experience with Terraform and CI/CD, along with SRE practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and cost alerts. In-depth MS SQL Server DBA knowledge. Certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, or ITIL. Prior experience with national cybersecurity-control audits. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to the operational stability and security posture of ******'s platform. Application Process Candidates interested in this Operations and Security Engineer role are encouraged to apply.

4ddf06b81514be47.description: About the Internship This is an HR Coordinator (Tamheer) internship opportunity with البيت الأهلي للتمويل, based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah. The internship is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, offering practical exposure to daily Human Resources operations. The intern will gain hands-on experience under the guidance of the team, focusing on supporting payroll, compensation, benefits, attendance, leave management, and employee record administration. Key Responsibilities The HR Coordinator will be involved in various aspects of human resources, with a focus on the following areas: 1. Payroll, Compensation, and Benefits Contribute to the preparation and review of payroll, compensation, and employee benefits statements under specialist supervision. Assist in updating payroll and benefits data in employee records. 2. Attendance and Leave Management Support the implementation of the attendance monitoring system and ensure employee compliance with official working hours. Monitor attendance, departure, and leave records, ensuring data accuracy and timely updates. Assist in applying leave policies (annual, sick, emergency, etc.) in accordance with approved holiday and leave policies. Aid in modifying attendance and leave forms as needed. 3. Employee Affairs and Records Support operational HR processes and assist in managing employee records and files. Assist in implementing procedures for promotions, secondments, and terminations, and record employee incidents according to approved procedures. Help update and document employee information (such as promotions and training courses) and provide it to the employee services team. 4. Employee Services Assist in receiving and professionally handling employee inquiries and requests. Escalate complaints and issues to the direct manager or department head. 5. Reporting and Documentation Assist in preparing periodic reports and documents related to HR operations. Contribute to storing documents and reports in the database according to approved policies. Assist in executing other related tasks as per business requirements and management directives. Experience and Qualifications This internship is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, providing a foundational learning experience in Human Resources. No specific academic qualifications were provided, but a relevant educational background is typically preferred for such roles. Work Location The internship is located in the Makkah region, with opportunities available in both Jeddah and Makkah cities.

4dfd393d0b2e5308.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Senior Specialist Business Planning to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the development and execution of business planning activities, enhancing planning methodologies, coordinating plans and schedules, monitoring performance, and providing analytical insights to facilitate effective decision-making and achieve organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities Contribute to enhancing business planning methodologies, frameworks, tools, templates, and processes, ensuring alignment with organizational requirements and best practices. Evaluate planning practices and recommend improvements based on business needs, performance analysis, and stakeholder feedback. Maintain and refine planning documentation, templates, and reporting tools to promote consistency, accuracy, and compliance. Support the standardization of planning approaches across business units to improve planning effectiveness and reporting quality. Analyze planning outputs and identify opportunities to strengthen planning processes, methodologies, and governance practices. Review project schedules, business plans, and related documentation to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and approved requirements. Prepare, maintain, and update integrated project schedules, tracking key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, critical paths, and timelines. Perform schedule and planning analysis to identify risks, potential delays, resource constraints, and deviations from approved plans. Assess planning scenarios and provide recommendations to support informed decision-making and effective execution. Coordinate planning activities with relevant stakeholders to facilitate issue resolution and maintain alignment across projects and initiatives. Monitor the status of action items, commitments, and deliverables, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. Support cross-functional communication and information sharing to enhance planning transparency and execution effectiveness. Prepare and consolidate business planning reports, dashboards, presentations, and performance updates for management and stakeholders. Analyze project and business performance data from multiple sources to identify trends, variances, risks, and improvement opportunities. Maintain accurate and up-to-date planning records, reports, and supporting documentation. Track and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) and planning metrics to support performance monitoring and continuous improvement initiatives. Provide planning insights and analytical findings to support business reviews and decision-making processes. Role Accountabilities Obtain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in business planning or a related field. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with various stakeholders and business units to ensure planning effectiveness and alignment with organizational objectives.

4d291948f14f8f9c.description: About the Role Seara International is seeking a Custom Clearance Section Head to manage import and export clearance operations. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The position is critical for ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining the integrity of the cold chain for frozen food products. Role Overview The Custom Clearance Section Head will oversee all aspects of import and export clearance for raw materials, packaging, equipment, and finished goods within a frozen food manufacturing environment. The primary objective is to ensure strict adherence to SFDA and customs regulations, prevent shipment holds, avoid cold-chain integrity loss, and minimize demurrage and detention fees. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Supervise and prepare all import/export shipping documentation, including Bills of Lading, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, Halal Certificates, and Health/Phytosanitary Certificates. Submit, monitor, and track customs declarations via government and customs portals (*, FASAH, SABER, Bayan, or regional equivalents). Ensure correct Harmonized System (HS) code classification and tariff application for raw food ingredients, frozen meat/poultry, dairy, and processing machinery. Coordinate with local food and drug regulatory authorities (*, SFDA, FDA) to obtain import permits, clearance approvals, and lab testing releases. Facilitate physical inspections, port sampling, and laboratory testing protocols for perishable and temperature-sensitive goods. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of national trade laws, food import restrictions, labelling standards, and shelf-life requirements. Prioritize release for reefer (refrigerated) containers to preserve cold-chain continuity and prevent product spoilage. Monitor reefer container plugged-in statuses and plug-in charges at ports and clearance zones. Liaise with customs brokers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, port authorities, and transport providers to expedite container release. Proactively resolve holds, documentation discrepancies, and inspection delays to mitigate demurrage, storage, and detention penalties. Direct and evaluate third-party customs clearing agents and brokers to ensure compliance with company KPIs and clearance turnaround times. Manage internal documentation clerks and clearance staff, assigning daily operational priorities. Maintain complete audit-ready clearance archives and submit periodic reports on clearance timelines, duty expenditures, and port charges. Key Performance Indicators Average Clearance Lead Time: Turnaround time for reefer container release from port arrival. Demurrage & Detention Cost Reduction: Elimination or minimization of avoidable port storage and reefer charges. Compliance Accuracy: Zero penalties or fines due to incorrect HS codes, missing permits, or documentation errors. Cold-Chain Continuity: Zero inventory losses caused by customs clearance delays. Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in customs clearance, logistics, or a related field, preferably within a frozen food manufacturing or similar environment. Demonstrated knowledge of SFDA and customs regulations. Experience with government and customs portals (*, FASAH, SABER, Bayan). Strong understanding of cold-chain standards and perishable goods handling. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with operational responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic frozen food manufacturing environment, requiring close coordination with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure efficient and compliant clearance processes.

4d39caf192508847.job_title: Senior Manager Paid Media Performance and MarTech
4d39caf192508847.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Senior Manager, Paid Media Performance and MarTech to provide senior leadership and end-to-end ownership of the company's paid media performance and marketing technology function. This full-time role involves setting the strategic direction to drive sustainable business growth through data-driven acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value. The position combines executive-level strategy with deep operational ownership of the Marketing Technology ecosystem to deliver measurable ROI at scale across all digital channels. Key Responsibilities Define and own the multi-year paid media and Marketing Technology strategy, ensuring alignment with CEER's commercial and growth objectives. Set the vision, priorities, and performance standards for the paid media and marketing technology function. Manage the marketing technology ecosystem, driving integration of CRM, product analytics, and paid media platforms to enable audience targeting, measurement, attribution, and campaign optimization. Provide strategic guidance to leadership on paid media performance, attribution, and MarTech investments to support informed decision-making and marketing effectiveness. Define, track, and continuously refine key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics, including Cost per Acquisition (CPA), Return on Advertising Spend (ROAS), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), conversion rates, and media efficiency metrics. Identify growth opportunities through performance analysis, audience insights, and market trends, and scale high-performing campaigns to maximize reach, conversions, and return on investment. Manage comprehensive paid media strategies across channels, including Search, Social, Programmatic & Display, Traditional, Affiliate, and Native platforms. Ensure accurate tracking, tagging, and data flow across all platforms. Ensure data integrity and privacy compliance with PDPL, GDPR, and other applicable regulations. Marketing Technology Leadership This role involves leading the selection, implementation, and optimization of critical marketing technology tools. This includes managing platforms such as CDPs (*, Segment, Tealium), Marketing Automation Platforms (Emarsys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze), Attribution Tools, and Tag Management Systems (GTM, Tealium IQ). Performance Measurement and Accountability The Senior Manager will be responsible for ensuring clear accountability for achieving agreed performance and business growth targets. This includes continuous refinement of KPIs and success metrics to drive marketing effectiveness and demonstrate measurable ROI. Required Experience Candidates should possess 8-10 years of relevant experience in paid media performance and marketing technology roles. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4d11668d5b3c172a.description: About the Role Deloitte is seeking a Client Account Manager to join its Client Account Management (CAM) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves driving and supporting strategic relationships within Deloitte's largest public sector accounts in the Kingdom. The successful candidate will work on-site with clients and the Deloitte account team, collaborating closely with the Lead Client Service Partner (LCSP), account directors, and engagement partners to foster account growth, deepen client relationships, and identify new opportunities from existing engagements. Key Responsibilities Manage account rhythm with the LCSP, including account plans, monthly narratives, and Quarterly Business Reviews. Work on-site with clients and engagement teams up to four days a week. Develop relationships with account leadership and stakeholders to drive initiatives aligned with account growth. Track engagement end dates and identify follow-on opportunities. Support the development and delivery of the account's short and long-term strategy for revenue growth, relationship strengthening, and profile enhancement. Understand client strategic issues, including Vision 2030 programs, budget cycles, and policy changes, and advise the account team. Identify "Must Win" opportunities and build cases for pricing support and pursuit investment. Originate opportunities through client relationships and identify RFPs before release. Maintain a tender calendar and support pursuits from qualification to submission, leveraging firm expertise. Coordinate with the Riyadh RFP team on submissions and report on win, loss, and abandoned rates. Develop a deep understanding of the account, the Saudi public sector, and the market. Equip partners with research and insights for client stakeholder conversations. Track competitor activity, including pricing, hires, wins, and positioning. Build a network within the account team and the wider firm, including industry leaders and business lines. Maintain relationships with the client's procurement team, understanding evaluation criteria and commercial expectations. Build relationships with the client's finance, PMO teams, and other relevant stakeholders below CXO level. Support account events and eminence activities. Manage the quality of the account pipeline in Salesforce, including stages, probabilities, and close dates. Prepare monthly account narratives with commentary on revenue, coverage, and pipeline for leadership. Ensure Deloitte is registered and current on client procurement portals, such as Etimad. Required Experience and Capabilities 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Ability to understand Deloitte's purpose and values, explore opportunities for impact, and act as a brand ambassador. Demonstrated commitment to personal learning and development. Understanding of expectations and personal accountability for performance. Active focus on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understanding of how daily work contributes to team and business priorities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires working on-site with clients and the Deloitte account team. Support for reporting and administration is provided by Deloitte's delivery center in Jordan, allowing the Client Account Manager to focus on client and account management.

4d11ac87c328316f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه الشبكات الرقميه للاتصالات عن فني كهروميكانيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ أعمال التشغيل والصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية والميكانيكية في مواقع الاتصالات، لضمان كفاءة التشغيل واستمرارية الخدمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية ولوحات التوزيع والتحكم. تشغيل وصيانة مولدات الديزل والكهرباء وأنظمة التحويل الآلي (ATS). فحص وصيانة أنظمة التكييف والتبريد في مواقع وشلترات الاتصالات. صيانة المضخات والرديترات وأنظمة التبريد والمكونات الميكانيكية. تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية والميكانيكية وتنفيذ الإصلاحات اللازمة. تنفيذ خطط الصيانة الوقائية والاستجابة لبلاغات الأعطال ميدانيًا. إعداد تقارير الصيانة والالتزام بإجراءات السلامة المهنية. المهام الفنية تحديد المخططات ونوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة استناداً إلى المخططات. توجيه جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين في تركيب وتنسيق النظم الكهروميكانيكية. اختبار النظم الكهروميكانيكية بعد تركيبها، وضمان التقيد بالمخططات والمواصفات. تنفيذ عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تقديم المساعدة التقنية للمهندسين في أنشطة البحث والتطوير للمعدات الكهروميكانيكية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة سابقة في الصيانة الكهروميكانيكية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال والتعامل مع المعدات الكهربائية والميكانيكية. الجدية والالتزام وتحمل مسؤولية العمل الميداني. يفضل وجود خبرة في مشاريع التشغيل والصيانة وقطاع الاتصالات. اشتراك ساري في الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين. بيئة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور العمل الميداني في مواقع الاتصالات بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في حفر الباطن. يجب على المتقدم أن يكون مستعداً للتعامل مع تحديات العمل الميداني والالتزام بإجراءات السلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص في شركه الشبكات الرقميه للاتصالات والمساهمة في ضمان استمرارية وكفاءة خدمات الاتصالات. الراتب غير معلن.

4d4c2049f18ddcfd.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Commercial Director to manage all contractual and commercial activities for a major project. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves overseeing commercial performance and ensuring compliance with project objectives, requiring over 10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage a team of commercial, procurement, and contract staff, including subconsultants, to analyze and evaluate project finances and contracts. Ensure commercial performance against established schedules, budgets, and critical project data. Provide guidance and specialized assistance to the project team for resolving commercial and contract-related issues. Oversee the commercial performance of assigned project areas, ensuring adherence to commercial procedures and objectives. Interface with the client team, attend meetings, and provide critical project updates, reports, and presentations. Assist with key contract negotiations and modifications to achieve favorable terms and conditions for the project. Establish and lead the implementation of strategic commercial project plans. Manage the successful commercial execution of assigned projects in coordination with the Senior Project Manager. Project Management and Reporting Assist with the development of work plans and budgets. Review project proposals and work plans to determine timelines, financial objectives, and procedures. Prepare project status reports, including updated cost projections and schedules for senior management and clients. Identify changes in scope or differing conditions and secure appropriate change orders for project cost and time, if approved. Review project progress reports and contract statuses, providing guidance and recommendations for improvements. Contractual and Claims Management Advise management on strategies to limit potential claims arising from non-adherence to project contract terms. Manage the review of contractual notices of claims and provide contractual advice to project delivery teams. Oversee the preparation and maintenance of Engineer’s Instructions, contract changes, variation orders, insurance, and claims logs. Facilitate contract close-out procedures to ensure compliance with all terms and conditions prior to final payment. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in commercial and contract management roles. Demonstrated ability to manage complex contracts and commercial activities for major projects. Experience in leading and developing commercial, procurement, and contract teams. Strong negotiation skills and experience in securing favorable contract terms. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with project responsibilities that may include Jeddah. 4d0c83f1250a41c2.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يبحث مجمع العناية الطبي المتخصص عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية وإعداد المرضى، بالإضافة إلى تشغيل الأجهزة واستخراج الصور وتقديم التقارير اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية وإعداد المرضى وفقاً لطلبات الأطباء المعالجين. تشغيل أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة واستخراج الصور وطباعتها. تفقد أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية بشكل دوري. تأمين ومراقبة مستلزمات التصوير الضرورية مثل الأفلام والأدوية. اتخاذ إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية لضمان السلامة. تنظيم مواعيد التصوير للمرضى. مرافقة المرضى إلى غرفة التصوير وتحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها، وتحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية ومواصفات الأشعة. تثبيت ألواح من الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير، واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة، والتقاط الصور الشعاعية. إظهار وتثبيت الصور الشعاعية، وتثبيت المعلومات الأساسية عليها، وتقديمها لطبيب أخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الأشعة. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والوقاية من الإشعاع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المواعيد وسير العمل. دقة عالية في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق المعلومات. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع المرضى والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأشعة ضمن فريق طبي متخصص في مجمع العناية الطبي، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مجمع العناية الطبي المتخصص، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

Department Marketing, KSA affiliate, International Operations Your impact begins here As Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing, you will own the integrated brand and portfolio strategy for our diabetes business in Saudi Arabia. You will turn affiliate priorities into clear growth, market-share and return-on-investment objectives, and lead a team that connects strategy, market development and field execution. From launch readiness to new channels and partnerships, your decisions will shape how our treatments reach healthcare professionals and people living with diabetes across KSA. Strong brand, portfolio, lifecycle, go-to-market and omnichannel / multichannel engagement capability. Strong business, commercial and financial acumen, and a data-driven approach to decisions. The ability to translate strategy into clear priorities and deliver results through others. Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills. A high patient and science orientation, with sound judgement across growth, evidence, access and compliance. What you’ll do You will set the strategic direction for the brand and portfolio plan, lead the team that brings it to life, and expand the market, channels and partnerships that drive sustainable growth. Lead in-depth analysis of market dynamics, prescribing habits, the competitive and access landscape and how patients and customers move through care – then define the annual and long-term brand and portfolio strategy, priority segments and go-to-market approach. Own the marketing budget and resource allocation, investing in the highest-impact initiatives. Set KPIs and governance to track forecasts, sales, market share, share of growth, customer engagement and campaign ROI, and act quickly when performance deviates. Integrate HCP, KOL/DOL, consumer, pharmacy and e-health touchpoints into coordinated omnichannel plans with clear content calendars, KPIs and owners – and make sure Sales and other execution teams understand the strategy, with training and feedback loops. Spend at least 20% of your time with target customers, working alongside the sales force on a regular visit plan. Identify growth whitespace, strategic accounts, new channels and partnerships; lead counterstrategies, lifecycle actions and launch readiness, including future indications and formulations. Direct external agencies, vendors and partners with clear briefs, governance, performance measures and budget discipline, so execution is high quality and compliant with Novo Nordisk policies and local regulations. Minimum requirements 3-4 years of brand management experience. Experience in diabetes therapy area is preferred. Portfolio management is an advantage. Previous track record with a team of direct reports is a plus. Who you’ll work with You will join the Marketing team in the KSA affiliate, part of International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to the Cardiometabolic Associate Director for HCP Marketing Your closest partners will be Sales, Medical, Market Access & Public Affairs, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement and People & Organisation, as well as Business Area and Region leadership. Outside Novo Nordisk, you will build relationships with key and digital opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, scientific societies, hospitals, patient advocacy groups and strategic commercial partners across KSA. What you can expect here You will be trusted to own decisions. Within agreed objectives and budget governance, you will set direction, allocate resources and approve or recommend priorities and investments – and you will see the results of those choices in the market. You will work with advanced analytics, market intelligence and AI-enabled tools, and lead experiments with new channels, digital health and omnichannel engagement, scaling what delivers measurable value. Clear performance expectations, honest feedback and a culture that rewards results will support you to grow as a leader while your team grows with you. Start now Your impact begins today. البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة والمتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم قوي لسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الموظفين والإدارة. القدرة على حل المشكلات والتعامل مع الشكاوى بمهنية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحديث البيانات وإعداد التقارير. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية لدعم عمليات الشركة.

4dfc52706ea129df.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة بان القابضة عن مدير فرع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى قيادة وإدارة عمليات الفرع ووحداته الإدارية، بما يضمن تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية والاستراتيجية للشركة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع وإعداد أهداف الفرع بما يتماشى مع التوجهات والاستراتيجيات العامة للجهة التابع لها. إدارة وتخطيط وتنظيم أعمال الفرع ووحداته الإدارية لضمان التوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية المعتمدة. متابعة كافة العمليات الإدارية المتعلقة بالفرع، وضمان توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية للفرع ومتابعة تنفيذها لتحقيق أفضل المخرجات وأعلى مستويات الكفاءة والإنتاجية. الإشراف العام على سير العمليات والإجراءات في الفرع، وضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المعتمدة. الإشراف على أداء موظفي الفرع، ومتابعة برامج الموارد البشرية الهادفة إلى تقييمهم وتطويرهم وتحفيزهم. بناء علاقات عمل مع الشركاء الخارجيين وتنسيق المشروعات والجهود المشتركة، وضمان قنوات تواصل داخلية فعالة بين إدارات الفرع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الفروع أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على وضع الخطط والأهداف ومتابعة تحقيقها. فهم عميق للعمليات الإدارية والتشغيلية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية ممتازة. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال. مهارات تواصل قوية لبناء العلاقات الداخلية والخارجية. القدرة على الإشراف على الأداء وتحفيز الفرق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق التميز التشغيلي والنمو المستمر للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4dcdb3a36d57cd5c.description: We are announcing a job opportunity for the position of HR Operations Specialist to join our team. We are looking for a candidate with experience and competence in managing day-to-day HR operations, with familiarity with Saudi Labor Law and related government platforms. Tasks and Responsibilities: Executing and managing employee-related HR operations, from recruitment and onboarding to offboarding. Preparing employment contracts, following up on their documentation and renewal, and completing onboarding and end-of-service procedures. Managing employee files, ensuring they are complete and continuously updated. Tracking leaves, attendance, and timekeeping, and updating relevant records. Executing and following up on procedures via government platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and MUDAD. Preparing and issuing letters, employment certificates, and employee-related documents. Ensuring compliance with company policies, Saudi Labor Law, and its executive regulations. Preparing periodic HR operations reports and contributing to process improvement and efficiency. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Practical experience in HR operations is an essential requirement . Excellent knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and its executive regulations. Experience in dealing with government platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and MUDAD. Proficiency in using HR systems and Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel. High organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize. Accuracy in work and maintaining the confidentiality of employee data. Effective communication skills and the ability to work within a team.

4d00307acfad70e2.description: About the Company: Skyworth Group is a leading global consumer electronics and smart home brand, with strong business presence across TVs, home appliances, energy storage, and smart devices worldwide. About the Role: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Market Assistant to support our marketing operations in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate is fluent in both Arabic and English, familiar with the Saudi market, and able to turn daily frontline insights into actionable input for the broader team. Key Responsibilities: Support daily sales associate training, including the preparation, translation, and localization of training materials such as product highlights and sales scripts. Translate and localize marketing assets between Arabic and English (and Chinese when needed), including product collateral, posters, POSM, training materials, and promotional content. Assist with social media operations by organizing product images, videos, copywriting, and other marketing assets. Support the execution and follow-up of new product launches, promotional campaigns, and other marketing activities. Collect, organize, and report frontline feedback on the market, competitors, and sales associates. Handle other tasks assigned by the Marketing Lead. Qualifications: Languages: Full professional fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is required. Chinese language skills are a strong plus. Experience: Prior experience in marketing, retail, consumer electronics, or a related field is preferred. Background: Experience in sales associate training, social media operations, or marketing campaign execution is a plus. 4d77ffc24201d9a7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحارى لخدمات الصيانة عن فني إطفاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. يركز الدور على دراسة وتتبع مخططات الإطفاء، وإعداد الخطط اللازمة، ومراقبة التنفيذ لضمان السلامة المهنية. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف فني الإطفاء إلى ضمان فعالية أنظمة الإطفاء وسلامة العمليات من خلال التخطيط الدقيق، وتحديد المتطلبات، والإشراف على التنفيذ. يشمل ذلك تطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتتبع المخططات المعدة لعمليات الإطفاء بدقة. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الإطفاء المختلفة. تحديد الأدوات والمعدات المطلوبة لإنجاز مهام الإطفاء. إعداد خطط الإطفاء ومراقبة تنفيذها لضمان الفعالية. ضبط عمليات الإطفاء وإعداد جداول تنفيذ الأعمال المتعلقة بها. توزيع المهام على المرؤوسين بشكل فعال. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية بدقة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الهندسية. معرفة بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في خدمات الصيانة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة صحارى لخدمات الصيانة.

4d49b07dae24d5b7.description: المسمى الوظيفي: بائع الهدف من الوظيفة: دعم العمليات اليومية وتحقيق التميز في خدمة العملاء داخل المعرض، مع الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والمحافظة على النظافة العامة والمظهر الجيد وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة والحفاظ على روح التعاون مع أعضاء الفريق. المساهمة في رفع مبيعات الفرع من خلال متابعة تحقيق الأهداف الشهرية ومقارنتها بالفترة نفسها من العام السابق. الالتزام بساعات العمل الرسمية وبلبس الزي الموحد المعتمد من الشركة. المحافظة على نظافة وتنظيم المعرض في جميع الأوقات. ضمان عدم وجود مخالفات حكومية من خلال الالتزام بجميع التعليمات التشغيلية. متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على تقليلها من خلال تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل فعال ومهارات البيع الالتزام، حسن المظهر وروح الفريق أيام العمل : 6 أيام في الاسبوع الإجازة الاسبوعية: يوم واحد (تكون الإجازة في وسط الاسبوع وليس في الويكيند) العمل بدوام كامل (8 ساعات) (يتم التعيين على شفت واحد سواء مسائي أو صباحي) ☀️ الشفت الصباحي 9 الصباح - 5 المساء 🌙الشفت المسائي 4 مساء - 12 منتصف الليل يمكن أن يتم التنقل بين الفروع القريبة هذه الوظيفة تتطلب استخراج بطاقة صحية (شهادة صحية) بعد التعيين

4dd8b3b546b16300.description: We are looking for a Material Expeditor to support material procurement, expediting, tracking, and delivery activities for rig-site operations in the Oil & Gas industry. The candidate will coordinate closely with suppliers, vendors, procurement teams, logistics teams, and site personnel to ensure all required materials are available on time and according to project requirements. Responsibilities Monitor and track material orders from purchase order placement through final delivery. Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to confirm material availability and delivery schedules. Follow up regularly on pending orders, delayed materials, shortages, and backorders. Coordinate with procurement, logistics, warehouse, and rig-site teams regarding material requirements. Maintain accurate material tracking sheets, delivery records, and related documentation. Review purchase orders and delivery information to ensure materials are supplied as required. Identify potential delivery delays and communicate issues to the concerned teams. Support the resolution of material shortages and delivery-related issues. Provide regular updates on material status, expected delivery dates, and outstanding items. Ensure critical materials are prioritized and delivered to the rig site as per operational requirements. Maintain proper records and documentation related to expediting activities. Work effectively in a fast-paced rig-site environment and meet operational deadlines. Fresh graduates to 5 years of relevant experience in material expediting, procurement, logistics, supply chain, or materials management. Oil & Gas, drilling, rig-site, or industrial project experience is preferred. Basic understanding of procurement and material management processes. Knowledge of purchase orders, material tracking, supplier coordination, and delivery schedules. Good communication and coordination skills. Strong follow-up and problem-solving abilities. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Ability to manage multiple material requirements and meet deadlines.

Core Responsibilities: Readiness governance and gates · Operate exit-gate governance across environments; verify prerequisites (access, certs, backups, rollback). · Supervise Go/No-Go forums and ensure documentation of risks, exceptions, and compensating controls with Cybersecurity sign-off. · Maintain change calendars aligned to asset windows and blackout periods.
